allowed_without_new_approval: Read stored sanitized job logs and existing diagnostics
Compare pinned package versions and source/configuration without importing or invoking TTS
Record GitHub runner OS/Python/package version only from existing evidence
Static lint of allowed fields and redaction policy

future_optional_checks_requiring_separat.boundaries: One specifically approved time-bounded and allowlisted network reachability/handshake diagnostic using legitimate documented interfaces, no synthesized text, audio, authentication bypass, proxy/region workaround or retries; whether handshake itself is permitted must be expressly granted
outputs: high-level HTTP/WebSocket status class and sanitized error category
elapsed time and coarse egress region only if safely available
future_optional_checks_requiring_separat.on_403: Record BLOCKED_UPSTREAM_403; stop immediately; do not auto-retry or launch TTS

sensitive_redaction.logs: Allowlisted structured fields only, redact before artifact creation; do not print traceback URL containing request parameters
sensitive_redaction.storage: Research-only minimal metadata with SHA256 and no raw handshake packet dump

fail_closed: Default deny for all outbound requests including DNS probes, HTTP and WebSocket
No import/invocation of edge_tts in preregistration or offline tests
Missing explicit narrow user permission => no network check
Unexpected response or 403 => BLOCKED, no automatic retry or dependency upgrade
No claim of service root cause solely from HTTP 403
Original M7 untouched and all execution/release locks false
acceptance: Document version and failure evidence boundaries
Explicitly name future optional data fields and prohibited secret-bearing fields
Document permission checkpoint and one-attempt stop policy
Independent static-only review before any future network test
Handoff retains Stage1 actual audio BLOCKED_UPSTREAM_403
